payload.text: Allied Automation - Apex | North Carolina Skip to content ALLIED AUTOMATION Custom Automation Equipment from Conceptualization through Design and Fabrication ABOUT Allied Automation designs and builds custom automated machines. We are a full-service automation group located in a modern facility near Raleigh, North Carolina. Established in 1989, Allied is a privately held corporation owned by people who work here every day. We offer an extensive array of services. Machine design, fabrication, machining, assembly, wiring, programming, and system runoff are all done in-house by our employees. WELCOME Allied Automation is your complete automation partner. We work with your project team to take your product from prototype through small batch production and process validation into turnkey high-volume production lines. Our services range from concept and process development through design, build, and commissioning of turnkey integrated assembly and test systems. Our equipment is installed at client sites around the world. Turnkey Custom Machines and Systems.
